title: Binance Copy Trading Launches Exclusive VIP Trading Fee Privileges for Eligible Lead Traders
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To thank our high-quality Lead Traders for their continued support of Binance, we are launching the  Exclusive Lead Trader VIP Fee Privilege Program . This program provides enhanced benefits for Futures Lead Traders who choose to trade exclusively on Binance. Eligible Lead Traders can enjoy an upgraded VIP fee tier. This benefit applies only to the  trading fee component of VIP status  and does not include other VIP privileges, such as sub-account benefits. For more information on the program, please refer to  this FAQ . About Binance Futures Copy Trading: Copy Trading allows users to copy experienced traders’ portfolios in real time. After determining the investment amount, the system will automatically copy trades from the lead traders’ portfolios that the users select. Novice traders may familiarize themselves with the crypto market via Copy Trading, and build up their strategizing and trading techniques. For More Information: What Is Futures Copy Trading How to Lead Trade on Binance Futures How to Use Copy Trading on Binance Futures Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-07-16
